priceNotification.noneDescription: Store prices and discounts already match the warehouse
priceNotification.cancelledTitle: Price reverted; pending notifications for {{count}} stores were withdrawn
priceNotification.cancelledAlso: Pending notifications for another {{count}} stores were withdrawn
priceNotification.previewRetail: After saving, the price is pushed to stores automatically and stores receive a "Label pending" notification. {{count}} stores currently have a different price
priceNotification.previewDiscountOnly: After saving, {{count}} stores with a different discount receive a "Price update" notification to confirm
priceNotification.previewSkipped: , {{count}} stores treat it as a special product and will be skipped
priceNotification.suggestedDiscountHint: Empty = do not compare store discounts; 0 = explicitly no discount. The suggested discount is never pushed to stores automatically.
priceNotification.suggestedDiscountSaveFailed: Product saved, but saving the suggested discount failed
priceNotification.batchSuggestedDiscountHint: Only applies when checked; empty = clear the suggested discount, 0 = explicitly no discount.
priceNotification.batchSuggestedDiscountFailed: Failed to set suggested discounts in batch
